description: Change a diary note: add to it (body with body_mode 'append'), rewrite it (body_mode 'replace'), fix the date or title, set or add tags, link a race or session. note_id comes from get_notes or add_note. Only the fields you send change. Training sessions are update_session, not this. All dates are the user's local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in their own time zone. Requires signing in.

add_tags.description: Add these tags, keeping the existing ones.

body.description: Text to append or the new body, see body_mode.

body_mode.description: 'append' adds the text as a new paragraph; 'replace' swaps the whole body. Default 'replace'.

note_id.description: ID of the note, from get_notes or add_note.

race_id.description: Link to a race (race_id from get_calendar); empty string unlinks.

session_id.description: Link to a session (session_id from get_calendar); empty string unlinks.

tags.description: Replace the tags with this list.

title.description: New title; empty string clears it.

name: update_note
title: Change a diary note
